Every push is read back and compared.
Refuses a book whose play time is not the file's,
and picks with it when a clue names several.

first, then the album tag, the title tag, the folder

The test lives here rather than in any one caller:
a caller that has to remember to ask is a caller

write a whole book's chapter list past one part's end
exactly as an album tag would.
